scope: The thirty-first unmerged LibreCAD patch adds an optional installed-upstream importer regression for the existing AC1024 title fixture. It requires the updated DWG reader from commit 50d075a4 or later.
validation: The actual LibreCAD importer test passed all five assertions: the Title_Block-ISO block exists with source handle 127, the preview is 2088 bytes, and its FNV-1a-64 content fingerprint is f881aec25d524b4f. The upstream focused regression compares all bytes directly against the BLOCK_HEADER callback.
The three focused installed-codec CTests passed. The test patch applies after the prior 30, and the older bundled-codec filter compile target still builds.
Source-release inventory passes with 1228 files and 18 refusal controls; the 725-input implementation digest remains d2fbf3b7e98738e05bc8f6a097b74ee429b43f58bcc8988a7bc92e6554a539c7.
limits: This is one existing fixture and an unmerged optional test. Preview rendering, output, richer title metadata and other platforms remain open; no drawing fixture was committed and no support claim is promoted.
